title: Lifeweave
basic_description: Restore 1 additional Health when you Leech.
astral_description: Restore 3 additional Health when you Leech.

title: Bloodbound
basic_description: Restore 1 additional Health when you Leech.
astral_description: Restore 2 additional Health when you Leech.

title: Infected
basic_description: Apply 1 Poison when you apply Bleed.
astral_description: Apply 2 Poison when you apply Bleed.

title: Ashen Wake
basic_description: Apply 1 Poison when you apply Burn.
astral_description: Apply 2 Poison when you apply Burn.

title: Cauterize
basic_description: Deal 1 Burn damage when you apply Bleed.
astral_description: Deal 2 Burn damage when you apply Bleed.

title: Contagion
basic_description: Poison has a 10% chance to increase instead of decreasing.
astral_description: Poison has a 20% chance to increase instead of decreasing.

title: Shatter
basic_description: Deal 2 additional damage while the enemy is Frozen.
astral_description: Deal 4 additional damage while the enemy is Frozen.

title: Executioner's
basic_description: Deal 3 additional damage if the enemy is below 30% Health.
astral_description: Deal 6 additional damage if the enemy is below 30% Health.

title: Riposte
basic_description: Deal 3 additional damage on your next attack after Dodging.
astral_description: Deal 6 additional damage on your next attack after Dodging.

title: Cascading
basic_description: Gain 1 Block when your Block is broken.
astral_description: Gain 2 Block when your Block is broken.

title: Second Wind
basic_description: Restore 8 Health the first time you fall below 25% Health.
astral_description: Restore 16 Health the first time you fall below 25% Health.

title: Deathgrip
basic_description: Gain 8 Block when on Death's Door.
astral_description: Gain 16 Block when on Death's Door.

title: Frostburn
basic_description: Increase Freeze damage by 2 against Burning enemies.
astral_description: Increase Freeze damage by 4 against Burning enemies.

title: Aetherward
basic_description: Gain 1 Block when you spend Mana.
astral_description: Gain 2 Block when you spend Mana.

title: Sanctum
basic_description: Gain 1 Block when you deal Holy damage.
astral_description: Gain 2 Block when you deal Holy damage.

title: Absolving
basic_description: Cleanse 1 status effect when you deal Holy damage.
astral_description: Cleanse 1 status effect when you deal Holy damage.

title: Beacon
basic_description: Restore 1 Health when you deal Holy damage.
astral_description: Restore 3 Health when you deal Holy damage.

title: Windfall
basic_description: Restore 1 Health when you gain Gold.
astral_description: Restore 2 Health when you gain Gold.

title: Knockout
basic_description: Deal 3 Physical damage when you Stun the enemy.
astral_description: Deal 5 Physical damage when you Stun the enemy.

title: Dazed
basic_description: Deal 2 additional damage while the enemy is Stunned.
astral_description: Deal 4 additional damage while the enemy is Stunned.

title: Branding
basic_description: Mark the enemy when they are Stunned.
astral_description: Mark the enemy when they are Stunned.

title: Nullifying
basic_description: Purge 1 status effect when you deal Holy damage.
astral_description: Purge 1 status effect when you deal Holy damage.

title: Disrupting
basic_description: Purge 1 status effect when you Stun the enemy.
astral_description: Purge all status effects when you Stun the enemy.

title: Unmaking
basic_description: Purge 1 status effect from the enemy when you Critically Hit.
astral_description: Purge all status effects from the enemy when you Critically Hit.

title: Arcane Ward
basic_description: Gain 2 Block when you gain Mana.
astral_description: Gain 4 Block when you gain Mana.

title: Bounty
basic_description: Gain 4 Gold when you defeat an enemy.
astral_description: Gain 8 Gold when you defeat an enemy.

title: Blur
basic_description: Gain 15% Dodge chance while below 50% Health.
astral_description: Gain 30% Dodge chance while below 50% Health.

title: Whiplash
basic_description: Deal 3 Stun damage when you Dodge.
astral_description: Deal 5 Stun damage when you Dodge.
